messages:
matt_infra: Starting rebalancing discussion — we're seeing more interruptions in us-west1 GPU pool, cost creeping up. Proposing to enforce min_on_demand_floor=15% for prod ML clusters and use spot-burst lanes for spikes. Thoughts?

sara_ops: What's the failure mode? Are we losing capacity due to AZ drain or instance type scarcity?

matt_infra: Mostly preemptions and insufficient Z-cushion. Two of five nodes dropped in zone-b causing scheduling backpressure. Latency SLOs spiking for small gen requests.

jing_eng: Can we shift burst to another region to reduce interruption correlation? us-west1 has limited A100 capacity this week. Maybe route burst to us-central1 as fallback.

oliver_cost: 15% floor sounds sane but we need cost calc. If floor=15% vs 10% we lose ~12k/month on committed usage for our fleet. Need runbook for fallback to cheaper quantized models when we lose on-demand.

matt_infra: Agreed. I sketched a simple heuristic: floor = max(ceil(peak_qps * p95_instance_tokens / instance_capacity * safety_margin), min_floor_min). Will paste config.

matt_infra: ```
# mixpool policy snippet
pool: prod-mixpool
min_on_demand_floor_pct: 15
burst_pools: [spot-a, spot-b]
fallback_regions: [us-central1]
eviction_credit_policy: "soft-evict-priority"
``` 

sara_ops: Can we add interruption_credits to tenants so long-running jobs migrate gracefully? e.g., keep 30s of KV cache credit so inflight streams finish.

deploy-bot: INFO: canary deploy of "mixpool-rebalance-v1" scheduled at 2165432400

jing_eng: +1 to eviction credits. Also recommend gradual drain: drain rate = min(10%/min, 1 node/min) to avoid thundering.

oliver_cost: Please run a cost projection and a failure-injection test (simulated spot-drain) before roll. I can help with numbers.

matt_infra: I'll schedule a small canary, run cost projection, and post results. Thanks all :thumbsup:
